title: Scaling Neural Motor Decoding via Decoupled Behavioral Pretraining
abstract: arXiv:2611.08263v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent neural decoding approaches achieve strong performance by training on large collections of paired neural-behavioral recordings, but such datasets are expensive, invasive, and difficult to scale. In contrast, behavioral data is abundant and easy to collect, raising the question of whether neural decoding can benefit from decoupling behavioral and neural representation learning. We introduce BEEMO, a flexible multi-session framework that enables training with arbitrary mixtures of paired neural-behavioral recordings and unpaired behavioral data. A behavior decoder learns movement dynamics directly from behavioral trajectories, while neural activity is incorporated through cross-attention layers when available, allowing behavioral and neural supervision to scale independently. Across multiple intracortical motor datasets and tasks in nonhuman primates, we show that incorporating unpaired behavioral data improves decoding performance

translated_title: 通过解耦行为预训练实现神经运动解码的规模化
translated_abstract: 最近的神经解码方法通过在大量配对的神经-行为记录数据集上训练获得了强大的性能，但这类数据集昂贵、具有侵入性且难以规模化。相比之下，行为数据丰富且易于收集，这引发了一个问题：神经解码能否从解耦行为与神经表征学习中受益。我们提出了BEEMO，这是一个灵活的多会话框架，支持使用任意比例配对的神经-行为记录与非配对行为数据进行训练。行为解码器直接从行为轨迹中学习运动动态，而神经活动在可用时通过交叉注意力层被纳入，从而使行为和神经监督能够独立扩展。在多个非人类灵长类动物的皮层内运动数据集和任务上，我们展示了引入非配对行为数据能够提升解码性能。
tldr: 提出BEEMO框架，通过解耦行为与神经表征学习，利用丰富且易获取的非配对行为数据进行训练，独立扩展行为和神经监督，从而在非人类灵长类皮层内运动数据集上显著提升解码性能。
en_tdlr: BEEMO, a flexible multi-session framework that decouples behavioral and neural representation learning, leverages abundant unpaired behavioral data alongside paired neural-behavioral recordings to independently scale supervision and improve motor decoding performance across intracortical datasets in nonhuman primates.
